nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Ubuntu 22.04 image used for local/CI testing of this chezmoi dotfiles repo: installs curl, git, bats, sudo, tzdata, parallel, and build-essential, creates a non-root sudo user, installs chezmoi itself, and sets the working directory to the chezmoi source path.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-stage Dockerfile; installs bats and parallel specifically to support running the repo's bats test suite inside the container.

nodes.name: agent-assets.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that validates agent, MCP, plugin, and skill metadata via a uv-run Python script on pull requests and pushes to main, and on a weekly schedule additionally checks upstream documentation links and current package versions (Codex, Claude Code, ty) to catch drift.

nodes.name: docs.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that deploys the project's MkDocs documentation site on pushes to main touching docs-relevant paths (README, Makefile, scripts, install, hooks), using mise to install tooling and `make deploy` to publish.

nodes.name: macos.yaml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that runs the dotfiles bootstrap (`setup.sh`) end-to-end on macOS, verifies idempotency by simulating post-apply local drift and confirming a rerun rejects it, runs an optional private-dotfiles benchmark, and executes the macOS bats file-existence test suite.

nodes.name: remote.yaml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow ("Snippet install") that exercises the one-line remote bootstrap snippet against an isolated HOME across Ubuntu/macOS client and server matrix combinations, verifying both the public checkout path and, when secrets are present, the private-dotfiles restoration path leave unmanaged files untouched.

nodes.name: test.yaml
nodes.summary: Required GitHub Actions unit-test workflow that always reports a status for PRs into main: a `changes` job computes a diff range and decides whether test-relevant files changed, a matrixed `test` job runs the bats suite with coverage across Ubuntu/macOS client/server combinations, and a `nix` job validates Nix-related changes.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately omits workflow-level path filters so the required check always completes, deferring the skip decision to job-level conditionals instead.

nodes.name: ubuntu.yaml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that runs the dotfiles bootstrap (`setup.sh`) on Ubuntu across server/client matrix targets, with optional private-dotfiles integration gated on repository secrets.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Primary project documentation covering overview, macOS/Ubuntu setup instructions, per-application install/setup, private credentials handling, update/test lifecycle, agent review and permission assets, the Herdr/Ghostty agent workspace, local and Docker testing, Bats unit testing, Codecov coverage, and licensing.

nodes.name: setup.sh
nodes.summary: Bootstrap shell script that installs chezmoi and initializes the dotfiles on a fresh macOS or Linux machine: fetches/verifies checksums, keeps sudo alive, performs OS-specific initialization (Homebrew on macOS), runs chezmoi init/apply, and restarts the shell.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses POSIX-compatible shell functions with CI/TTY detection guards and checksum verification before executing fetched remote content, a security-conscious bootstrap pattern.

nodes.name: docker
nodes.summary: Make target that builds (if needed) and runs a Docker container mounting the repo as the chezmoi source, for testing the dotfiles setup in an isolated Linux environment.

nodes.name: setup
nodes.summary: Make target that delegates to setup.sh to bootstrap the dotfiles on a new machine.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Make target that runs chezmoi init --apply and, if available, initializes the private dotfiles overlay via chezmoi-private.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Make target that applies public and private chezmoi state, installs pinned mise tools, refreshes agent assets, reloads the Herdr server config if running, and triggers the agmsg-bootstrap target.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Make target alias that simply depends on and runs the update target.

nodes.name: doctor
nodes.summary: Make target that runs the tool-check and agent-runtime-check scripts and prints a combined pass/fail health summary for the local environment.

nodes.name: upgrade
nodes.summary: Make target that runs the tool-upgrade script (optionally in system mode) and re-triggers the agmsg-bootstrap target.

nodes.name: agmsg-bootstrap
nodes.summary: Make target that bootstraps the agmsg cross-agent messaging setup via the herdr-agents helper script, if present.

nodes.name: require-crit-review
nodes.summary: Make target that gates completion on an agent code review by invoking require-crit-review.py with review-evidence environment variables.

nodes.name: validate-agent-assets
nodes.summary: Make target that validates agent configuration assets via validate-agent-assets.py.

nodes.name: unit-test
nodes.summary: Make target that runs the Python unittest discovery suite under tests/unit.

nodes.name: docs
nodes.summary: Make target that generates docs content, refreshes the MkDocs table of contents, and performs a strict MkDocs build.

nodes.name: serve
nodes.summary: Make target that builds docs and serves the MkDocs site locally on the configured host/port.

nodes.name: deploy
nodes.summary: Make target that builds docs and deploys the MkDocs site to GitHub Pages via gh-deploy.

nodes.name: clean
nodes.summary: Make target that removes generated documentation output directories and files.

nodes.name: fetch_url
nodes.summary: Downloads content from a URL using curl or wget, whichever is available, abstracting the fetch mechanism used elsewhere in the bootstrap script.

nodes.name: fetch_file
nodes.summary: Fetches a remote file to a local path using fetch_url, used to download chezmoi installer assets and checksum manifests.

nodes.name: verify_sha256
nodes.summary: Verifies a downloaded file's SHA-256 checksum against an expected value before it is trusted and executed, a security guard in the bootstrap flow.

nodes.name: keepalive_sudo_linux
nodes.summary: Keeps the sudo session alive on Linux by periodically refreshing credentials in a background loop during the setup run.

nodes.name: keepalive_sudo_macos
nodes.summary: Keeps the sudo session alive on macOS by periodically refreshing credentials in a background loop during the setup run.

nodes.name: keepalive_sudo
nodes.summary: Dispatches to the OS-appropriate sudo keepalive implementation and registers cleanup so the background refresh loop stops when the script exits.

nodes.name: initialize_os_macos
nodes.summary: Performs macOS-specific initialization for the bootstrap process, including Homebrew installation and any macOS prerequisite setup needed before chezmoi runs.

nodes.name: initialize_os_env
nodes.summary: Dispatches OS-specific initialization (macOS vs Linux) based on the detected OS type before continuing the chezmoi bootstrap.

nodes.name: run_chezmoi
nodes.summary: Core bootstrap routine that downloads, verifies, and installs chezmoi if needed, then runs chezmoi init and apply against this dotfiles repository, handling CI/non-interactive and interactive modes.

nodes.name: initialize_dotfiles
nodes.summary: Top-level orchestration step that sets up sudo keepalive, OS-specific initialization, and invokes run_chezmoi to apply the dotfiles.

nodes.name: restart_shell_system
nodes.summary: Restarts the user's shell for the detected system/platform after the dotfiles have been applied, so new configuration takes effect immediately.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point function that runs initialize_dotfiles and then restarts the shell, tying together the full bootstrap sequence executed when setup.sh is invoked.

nodes.name: README.md

nodes.name: agent-config.yaml
nodes.summary: Canonical, hand-edited source of truth for shared Codex and Claude Code agent settings: schema version, target agents, shared skills list, model profiles (deep/express/review/standard), interactive profile, and per-agent Codex/Claude sections plus plugin and MCP server definitions, from which all agent-native config files are generated.

nodes.name: model-profiles.env
nodes.summary: Generated shell fragment (sourced by herdr-agents and agent-fanout launchers) exposing model-profile CLI argument strings for deep, express, review, and standard profiles across both Claude and Codex agents, plus the default interactive profile name.
nodes.languageNotes: Auto-generated from agent-config.yaml by scripts/generate-agent-configs.py; should not be hand-edited.

nodes.name: permgate-policy.yaml
nodes.summary: Security policy configuration for the permgate PermissionRequest classifier: pins the Claude/Codex classifier models (disabled by default), sets confidence/timeout/enablement thresholds, and enumerates whitelisted read-only action categories (repo view, issue/PR status, diffs, version checks) with an explicit fail-to-unknown classifier prompt.

nodes.name: actas-claim.sh
nodes.summary: Pre-flight claim script for the actas skill-command flow: looks up which team/name pairs a registered agent belongs to and attempts to claim the actas exclusivity lock for each pair against a session id.

nodes.name: check-inbox.sh
nodes.summary: Checks the agmsg inbox across all of an agent's teams with a cooldown so repeated hook invocations do not spam checks more than once per configured interval.

nodes.name: config.sh
nodes.summary: Manages agmsg's YAML configuration file, exposing get/set/show subcommands backed by hand-rolled YAML parsing and editing helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a minimal YAML reader/writer (yaml_get/yaml_set) in pure bash rather than depending on an external YAML tool.

nodes.name: delivery.sh
nodes.summary: Central controller for agmsg message delivery modes (monitor/turn/both/off): writes per-agent hook settings for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and Copilot, manages watcher processes, and reports delivery status.
nodes.languageNotes: The largest script in the skill; branches into per-CLI settings writers (apply_settings_copilot, apply_settings_gemini, apply_settings) that each hand-edit that tool's hook config file.

nodes.name: history.sh
nodes.summary: Displays agmsg message history for a team, optionally filtered to one agent's sent/received messages, formatted oldest-first with read/unread markers.

nodes.name: hook.sh
nodes.summary: Deprecated backward-compatible alias that forwards on/off actions to delivery.sh's set turn/off subcommands, predating the delivery-mode redesign.

nodes.name: identities.sh
nodes.summary: Lists all (team, agent) pairs registered for a given project path and agent type, deduplicated, one tab-separated pair per line.

nodes.name: inbox.sh
nodes.summary: Shows unread messages for a team/agent and marks them as read, with a --quiet flag that suppresses output when there is nothing unread (used by hooks).

nodes.name: init-db.sh
nodes.summary: Initializes the agmsg SQLite messages database, creating the schema if it does not already exist.

nodes.name: join.sh
nodes.summary: Adds an agent to an agmsg team, creating the team's config if it does not yet exist.

nodes.name: leave.sh
nodes.summary: Removes an agent from an agmsg team and deletes the team entirely once it becomes empty.

nodes.name: rename-team.sh
nodes.summary: Renames an agmsg team by moving its teams/ directory, updating the config.json name field, and rewriting the team column of past messages in the database.

nodes.name: rename.sh
nodes.summary: Renames an agent within a team's config and updates all of that agent's historical messages in the database to the new name.

nodes.name: reset.sh
nodes.summary: Removes an agent's registrations for a project/type across all teams and releases any actas exclusivity locks that session owned, returning the role to the pool for peer sessions.

nodes.name: send.sh
nodes.summary: Sends a message from one agent to another within a team by inserting a row into the agmsg SQLite messages table, initializing the database on first use.

nodes.name: session-end.sh
nodes.summary: SessionEnd hook that is the symmetric counterpart of session-start.sh; reads the session id from hook input JSON on stdin and releases actas locks and delivery state when a Claude Code session terminates.

nodes.name: session-start.sh
nodes.summary: SessionStart hook for the monitor/both delivery modes; reads the session id from hook input JSON and emits an instruction directing Claude to invoke the Monitor tool against watch.sh for live message delivery.

nodes.name: modify_deep.config.toml
nodes.summary: Chezmoi modify_ script (a Python program despite the .toml name) that renders Codex's "deep" model profile (gpt-5.6-sol, high reasoning effort) and merges it with Codex-owned runtime state (hook trust, marketplaces, projects) read from stdin, so `codex --profile deep` gets managed settings without clobbering runtime data.
nodes.languageNotes: Chezmoi 'modify_' scripts are executed at apply time and their stdout becomes the target file content; this one is Python (shebang #!/usr/bin/env python3) even though its filename and detected language are TOML.

nodes.name: modify_express.config.toml
nodes.summary: Chezmoi modify_ script that renders Codex's "express" model profile (gpt-5.6-luna, low reasoning effort) and merges it with Codex-owned runtime state read from stdin, so `codex --profile express` gets managed settings without clobbering runtime data.
nodes.languageNotes: Same merge algorithm as the sibling deep/review/standard profile scripts, differing only in the embedded MANAGED profile literal (model id and reasoning effort).

nodes.name: modify_private_config.toml
nodes.summary: Chezmoi modify_ script for Codex's base config.toml (not profile-scoped): renders the managed baseline template from .chezmoitemplates/codex-config-managed.toml and merges it with Codex-owned runtime tables (hooks.state, marketplaces, tui.model_availability_nux, projects) supplied on stdin.
nodes.languageNotes: Unlike the per-profile scripts, this one loads its managed content from an external chezmoi template file (source_dir()) rather than an inline MANAGED string, and resolves CHEZMOI_SOURCE_DIR/CHEZMOI_HOME_DIR env vars for path substitution.

nodes.name: modify_review.config.toml
nodes.summary: Chezmoi modify_ script that renders Codex's "review" model profile (gpt-5.6-sol, low reasoning effort) and merges it with Codex-owned runtime state read from stdin, so `codex --profile review` gets managed settings without clobbering runtime data.
nodes.languageNotes: Same merge algorithm as the sibling deep/express/standard profile scripts, differing only in the embedded MANAGED profile literal (model id and reasoning effort).

nodes.name: modify_standard.config.toml
nodes.summary: Chezmoi modify_ script that renders Codex's "standard" model profile (gpt-5.6-terra, medium reasoning effort) and merges it with Codex-owned runtime state read from stdin, so `codex --profile standard` gets managed settings without clobbering runtime data.
nodes.languageNotes: The merge_config routine also cross-checks hook trust hashes against the base ~/.codex/config.toml and warns on stderr if a profile's trusted_hash diverges from the base config's, without recalculating or blindly trusting either.

nodes.name: config.py

nodes.name: hook.py
nodes.summary: Provides the non-enforcing Claude hook entry point that normalizes events into a durable spool, opportunistically drains them, and prunes expired operational artifacts at session end.

nodes.name: process_payload
nodes.summary: Resolves project state, normalizes and spools one hook payload, drains it without blocking, and performs best-effort retention cleanup on session end.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Reads a JSON hook payload from stdin, delegates processing, records input failures when possible, and always exits successfully.

nodes.name: memory.py
nodes.summary: Extracts durable memory candidates from normalized hook events using explicit bilingual markers and conservative heuristics, and compacts repeated text within a character budget.
nodes.languageNotes: A frozen dataclass represents candidates, while Japanese and English markers share a normalized kind vocabulary.

nodes.name: MemoryCandidate
nodes.summary: Immutable value object describing a candidate memory and deriving a stable content fingerprint from its normalized kind and text.

nodes.name: _sentences
nodes.summary: Splits multilingual prompt text into candidate sentences with a line-based fallback for long unsplit content.

nodes.name: extract_candidates
nodes.summary: Maps compact summaries, prompts, failures, and turn outcomes into scored memory candidates, prioritizing explicit markers over keyword heuristics.

nodes.name: compress_lines
nodes.summary: Deduplicates normalized text fragments and preserves both historical head and recent tail when enforcing a character limit.

nodes.name: normalize.py
nodes.summary: Sanitizes heterogeneous Claude hook payloads before persistence and converts them into bounded, hashed ContextDB event records with file references and memory candidates.
nodes.languageNotes: Normalization is deliberately performed after redaction and before spooling, preserving a strict no-raw-secrets-on-disk boundary.

nodes.name: _stringify
nodes.summary: Converts arbitrary values into deterministic human-readable strings while preserving strings and empty nulls.

nodes.name: _tool_summary
nodes.summary: Builds a bounded one-line success or failure summary from a tool name, its most informative input field, and any error.

nodes.name: _relative_path
nodes.summary: Normalizes a possible filesystem reference relative to the project root while safely retaining external or unresolvable paths.

nodes.name: _extract_file_refs
nodes.summary: Finds unique file references in sanitized inputs and responses, labels their operations, and classifies sensitive paths as restricted.

nodes.name: encode_detail
nodes.summary: Serializes event details within a strict size budget, progressively truncating fields while retaining source size and SHA-256 provenance.

nodes.name: normalize_hook_payload
nodes.summary: Maps every supported Claude hook event into a sanitized, size-bounded event schema with timestamps, hashes, retention, sensitivity, file references, and extracted memories.

nodes.name: paths.py
nodes.summary: Resolves the active project root and constructs its ContextDB state layout, including race-safe creation and validation of a persistent project identifier.
nodes.languageNotes: First-run project identity uses exclusive file creation plus a bounded retry to handle concurrent hook initialization.

nodes.name: ProjectPaths
nodes.summary: Immutable bundle of project-local ContextDB paths whose ensure method creates the required private directory hierarchy.

nodes.name: resolve_project_root
nodes.summary: Chooses and resolves the project root from an explicit path, environment, hook payload, or current directory.

nodes.name: _load_or_create_project_id
nodes.summary: Loads a validated hexadecimal project identity or creates one exclusively, retrying briefly when concurrent initialization wins the race.

nodes.name: project_paths
nodes.summary: Builds, initializes, and returns the complete project-local ContextDB path set with its persistent project identity.

nodes.name: probe.py
nodes.summary: Generates evaluation probes and ground truth for session failures, modified files, decisions, and unfinished work from persisted events and active memories.

nodes.name: generate_probes
nodes.summary: Builds session-specific recall, artifact, decision, and continuation questions with answers derived from database state.

nodes.name: recall.py
nodes.summary: Implements hybrid ContextDB recall by fusing normalized SQLite FTS and optional semantic scores, then expanding event results through tool, temporal, and shared-file relationships.
nodes.languageNotes: Reciprocal score ranges are normalized independently before rho-weighted fusion; semantic failure degrades to lexical search.

nodes.name: normalize_scores
nodes.summary: Min-max normalizes a score mapping, assigning one to every item when all raw scores are equal.

nodes.name: _key
nodes.summary: Creates a stable result key from a record type and its corresponding UUID field.

nodes.name: _event
nodes.summary: Converts an event database row into the common recall record shape without its internal score column.

nodes.name: _memory
nodes.summary: Converts a memory database row into the common recall record shape without its internal score column.

nodes.name: _lexical
nodes.summary: Queries event and visible-memory FTS indexes for an exact escaped phrase and returns canonical rows with BM25-derived scores.

nodes.name: _semantic
nodes.summary: Runs optional semantic memory search only when enabled embeddings exist and degrades to an empty result on provider failure.

nodes.name: _closure
nodes.summary: Finds deduplicated events related to a parent through tool-use identity, adjacent session position, or shared file references.

nodes.name: recall
nodes.summary: Fuses lexical and semantic rankings, applies deterministic tie-breaking, and fills the top-k results with lower-weight closure neighbors.

nodes.name: recover_hook.py
nodes.summary: Implements the SessionStart recovery hook, draining durable spool records before assembling session-scoped recovery context and returning structured hook output. It records failures without contaminating stdout.

nodes.name: recovery_output
nodes.summary: Resolves project configuration, drains pending events, and builds the additional SessionStart context for a supplied session.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Reads the hook payload from stdin, emits the sole structured stdout response, and falls back to a diagnostic recovery message on failure.

nodes.name: recovery.py
nodes.summary: Builds a bounded, injection-aware recovery packet from session events, modified files, durable memories, open tasks, failures, and compact summaries. It allocates configured character budgets across stable sections.

nodes.name: _detail
nodes.summary: Decodes an event detail JSON field and safely returns an empty mapping for malformed or non-object content.

nodes.name: _modified_files
nodes.summary: Summarizes per-file write and edit activity for a session while fitting the result into a strict character budget.

nodes.name: _render_packet
nodes.summary: Renders recovery sections in a fixed order and shares the remaining character allowance across non-empty bodies.

nodes.name: build_recovery_context
nodes.summary: Queries session-local ledger evidence and curated memories to produce the complete bounded recovery context, including verification guidance and explicit prompt-injection warnings.

nodes.name: redaction.py
nodes.summary: Sanitizes nested hook payloads before persistence by detecting credential patterns, sensitive keys, and sensitive file paths. It preserves omission hashes and reports redaction categories for auditability.

nodes.name: RedactionReport
nodes.summary: Tracks the number, categories, and sensitive-path status of redactions applied to a payload.

nodes.name: is_sensitive_path
nodes.summary: Classifies paths as sensitive using normalized directory, filename, suffix, and credential-name signals.

nodes.name: _replacement
nodes.summary: Formats a category-aware redaction marker and falls back to a generic marker for invalid templates.

nodes.name: redact_text
nodes.summary: Applies all configured high-signal credential patterns to text while recording each matched redaction category.

nodes.name: _key_is_sensitive
nodes.summary: Normalizes object keys and detects configured or suffix-based credential field names.

nodes.name: find_paths
nodes.summary: Recursively extracts path-valued fields from nested dictionaries and lists for sensitivity checks.

nodes.name: redact_value
nodes.summary: Recursively redacts strings and sensitive keys, suppresses captured file content when required, and hashes omitted values for traceability.

nodes.name: sanitize_payload
nodes.summary: Combines redaction and capture settings with discovered paths to sanitize an arbitrary payload and return its audit report.

nodes.name: semantic.py
nodes.summary: Provides an opt-in external embedding adapter with strict command, model, vector-count, dimension, and finite-number validation. It also implements cosine similarity for semantic memory ranking.

nodes.name: SemanticConfig
nodes.summary: Immutable configuration for the external semantic embedding command and batching limits.

nodes.name: semantic_config
nodes.summary: Parses semantic settings and rejects shell-command strings in favor of an explicit executable argument array.

nodes.name: embed_texts
nodes.summary: Invokes the configured embedding process with JSON input and validates its exit status, model identity, vector count, dimensions, and numeric values.

nodes.name: cosine_similarity
nodes.summary: Computes cosine similarity, returning sentinel values for mismatched dimensions and zero norms.

nodes.name: spool.py
nodes.summary: Implements durable event spooling and serialized SQLite ingestion using cross-platform file locks. Invalid records are quarantined, duplicate event UUIDs remain idempotent, and operational failures are recorded separately.

nodes.name: validate_ingestion_source
nodes.summary: Validates bounded lowercase ingestion-source identifiers before they enter persisted spool metadata.

nodes.name: DrainResult
nodes.summary: Captures lock acquisition, processing, insertion, duplication, quarantine, remaining-file, and error outcomes from a spool drain.

nodes.name: WriterLock
nodes.summary: Provides a context-managed, cross-platform exclusive writer lock with optional bounded waiting.

nodes.name: record_error
nodes.summary: Appends a bounded structured error record without allowing telemetry failure to disrupt hook execution.

nodes.name: spool_event
nodes.summary: Writes an event envelope exactly once to a uniquely named incoming spool file with restrictive permissions.

nodes.name: _quarantine
nodes.summary: Moves a rejected spool record into quarantine and records the rejection reason.

nodes.name: drain_spool
nodes.summary: Acquires the writer lock, validates and ingests a bounded batch of spool files transactionally, quarantines malformed records, and reports remaining work.

nodes.name: storage.py
nodes.summary: Defines the SQLite schema and central ContextStore for durable events, sessions, memories, hierarchical memory blocks, full-text search, and semantic embeddings. It also handles integrity checks, retention, export, and restrictive file permissions.

nodes.name: ContextStore
nodes.summary: Owns ContextDB schema initialization, idempotent event ingestion, session projections, memory lifecycle and hierarchy, lexical and semantic search, health checks, retention, and export.

nodes.name: util.py
nodes.summary: Provides deterministic JSON, hashing, timestamp, truncation, chunking, permission, and crash-resistant file-write primitives shared across ContextDB. Its exclusive and atomic writers fsync content and parent directories where supported.

nodes.name: utc_now
nodes.summary: Returns the current timezone-aware UTC datetime.

nodes.name: utc_iso
nodes.summary: Formats a datetime as millisecond-precision UTC ISO 8601 text with a Z suffix.

nodes.name: epoch_ms
nodes.summary: Converts a supplied or current UTC datetime to Unix epoch milliseconds.

nodes.name: canonical_json
nodes.summary: Serializes values to compact, key-sorted UTF-8 JSON suitable for stable hashing and persistence.

nodes.name: pretty_json
nodes.summary: Serializes values to readable, key-sorted JSON for diagnostics and bounded rendering.

nodes.name: sha256_text
nodes.summary: Returns the SHA-256 digest of UTF-8 text using replacement for encoding errors.

nodes.name: stable_id
nodes.summary: Builds a deterministic bounded identifier from separator-delimited string parts.

nodes.name: one_line
nodes.summary: Normalizes arbitrary content to one whitespace-collapsed line and truncates it to a configured limit.

nodes.name: truncate_middle
nodes.summary: Truncates long text by retaining a larger prefix and a trailing suffix around a marker.

nodes.name: normalize_for_fingerprint
nodes.summary: Case-folds text and collapses whitespace to produce stable fingerprint input.

nodes.name: ensure_dir
nodes.summary: Creates a directory tree and applies the requested restrictive mode where supported.

nodes.name: safe_chmod
nodes.summary: Applies POSIX-style permissions while tolerating filesystems and platforms without compatible modes.

nodes.name: _write_all
nodes.summary: Loops on low-level writes until the complete byte buffer is persisted or a short-write error occurs.

nodes.name: _fsync_directory
nodes.summary: Best-effort fsyncs a parent directory on non-Windows platforms to harden file metadata updates.

nodes.name: write_text_exclusive
nodes.summary: Creates a text file exclusively, writes and fsyncs all bytes, then secures the file and parent-directory metadata.

nodes.name: write_json_exclusive
nodes.summary: Persists canonical JSON through the exclusive text writer.

nodes.name: atomic_write_text
nodes.summary: Writes text to a unique temporary file, fsyncs it, atomically replaces the target, and cleans up leftovers.

nodes.name: append_jsonl
nodes.summary: Appends one canonical JSON record to a JSONL file with fsync and restrictive permissions.

nodes.name: parse_utc
nodes.summary: Parses ISO timestamps into timezone-aware UTC datetimes and returns none for absent or invalid values.

nodes.name: chunks

tour.title: リポジトリ全体像
tour.description: README は、このリポジトリが macOS と Ubuntu の環境を chezmoi で再現するための dotfiles 集であることを説明します。導入、秘密情報、更新、テスト、エージェント運用までの入口を示すため、以降の各層を読むための地図になります。

tour.title: 初回セットアップ
tour.description: setup.sh は新しい macOS または Linux 環境で chezmoi を導入し、このリポジトリを初期化・適用する bootstrap の中心です。OS 固有の初期化とシェルの再起動まで扱うため、README の手順が実際にどのように実行されるかを確認できます。

tour.title: 適用するホーム設定
tour.description: bootstrap の次は、chezmoi が利用者のホームディレクトリへ展開する設定の境界を見ます。.chezmoi.yaml.tmpl が適用の基本設定を担い、.chezmoiexternal.yaml.tmpl が外部から取得する管理対象を分けることで、公開 dotfiles と補助資産を整理しています。

tour.title: エージェント設定の正本
tour.description: ホーム設定の中でも agent-config.yaml は Codex と Claude Code の共有設定を集約する手編集の正本です。モデルプロファイル、共有 skill、プラグイン、MCP 定義を一か所で決めるため、個別の生成済み設定を直接変更しない設計を理解できます。

tour.title: 生成と整合性検証
tour.description: 正本の設定は generate-agent-configs.py により Codex、Claude、MCP、marketplace、モデルプロファイル用の資産へ展開されます。続く validate-agent-assets.py は多数の関連資産を横断して検証するため、生成物の手作業によるずれを早期に見つける保守の要です。

tour.title: ContextDB の入口
tour.description: 生成・検証されたエージェント環境の実行時には、ContextDB の薄い CLI と hook ラッパーが vendored package へ処理を渡します。cli.py はイベント取込と検索を提供し、hook.py は Claude のイベントを失わない spool へ送りつつ、セッション終了時の保守も行う入口です。

tour.title: 安全なイベント保存
tour.description: 入口で受けた異種の hook payload は normalize.py と redaction.py で正規化・秘匿化され、spool.py から SQLite の ContextStore へ直列かつ冪等に取り込まれます。共有 util.py の決定的 JSON、hash、atomic write がこの経路を支え、障害時にも監査可能なイベント履歴を残します。
tour.languageLesson: Python の context manager は lock や SQLite 接続の取得・解放を同じ構文で囲み、例外時にも資源を確実に解放するために使えます。

tour.title: 記憶検索とセッション回復
tour.description: 保存済みイベントから memory.py が再利用可能な記憶候補を抽出し、recall.py が全文検索と任意の semantic score を統合して関連情報を探します。recovery.py と recover_hook.py はその結果、変更ファイル、未完了タスク、失敗情報を文字数制限内の安全な回復 packet にまとめ、次のセッションへ文脈を戻します。

tour.title: 日常運用の入口
tour.description: Makefile は chezmoi の setup/apply、更新、診断、テスト、エージェント資産の検証、レビューゲート、文書化をまとめる最上位の操作面です。ここを読むことで、前の設定生成や ContextDB を含む保守作業を個別スクリプトではなく一貫したターゲットとして実行する流れが分かります。
tour.languageLesson: Makefile の target は依存関係と処理をまとめ、.PHONY を使うと同名ファイルの有無に左右されない操作コマンドとして定義できます。

tour.title: ローカル検証コンテナ
tour.description: Dockerfile は Ubuntu 22.04 上に chezmoi、Bats、sudo などを用意し、ローカルと CI で dotfiles を検証する実行環境を定義します。Makefile の運用を実機だけに依存させず、再現可能な Linux 環境でも試せるようにする基盤です。
tour.languageLesson: Dockerfile は変更頻度の低い依存関係を先に置くとレイヤーキャッシュを活用できます。このリポジトリでは検証用ツールを明示的に入れ、同じ環境をローカルと CI で共有します。

tour.title: クロスプラットフォーム CI
tour.description: GitHub Actions は PR に必要なテスト結果を常に返し、変更検出後に Ubuntu/macOS と client/server の組み合わせで検証します。macOS と Ubuntu の個別 workflow は setup.sh を end-to-end で実行するため、Step 2 の bootstrap が両プラットフォームで期待どおり動くことを確かめます。
tour.languageLesson: GitHub Actions の workflow は event、jobs、steps で構成されます。matrix を使うと同じ検証を OS や役割の組み合わせに展開でき、dotfiles の環境差分を継続的に検出できます。

tour.title: 運用ドキュメント公開
tour.description: 最後に generate-docs.sh と mkdocs.yml を見て、シェル資産から参照用 Markdown を生成し、MkDocs Material のサイトとして公開する流れを確認します。README から始めた学習経路を継続的に整備・配布する仕組みであり、設定と運用知識を利用者へ戻す最終層です。
